name: Scope creep
description: Whoever you shipped to 'just remembered' a few requirements. Backlog +75.

name: Model deprecation
description: Your AI vendor sunsets the model your agents run on. Finish rate -30% for 30 days while you limp along on a degraded fallback.

name: Runaway agent loop
description: An agent gets stuck retrying itself and burns through budget before anyone notices. Costs $60.

name: Usage overage
description: A traffic spike blows past the capacity you sized for. Keep the lights on is $40/day higher for 3 days.

name: Cloud credit
description: The host posted a credit. Keep the lights on is $12/day lower for 14 days.
